pros: Excellent value for money and competitive pricing.
Secure password sharing and management for teams.
Simple user interface and straightforward functionality.
cons: Autofill can sometimes be inconsistent or messy.
Admin features for collections and permissions are somewhat disjointed.
User interface lacks some of the polish found in competitors.
changed: Con 2: 'Admin features for collections and permissions could be more intuitive' was changed to 'Admin features for collections and permissions are somewhat disjointed' because the note 'After creating the organization the app jumps from Password Manager into a separate Admin Console with its own sidebar, so my saved CRM and note items were not visible where collections and members are managed' directly illustrates a disjointed experience rather than just a lack of intuition.
